decisive_items: right femoral aplasia and left femoral hypoplasia
Right unilateral cleft lip and palate
response.rationale: R1 uniquely combines the pathognomonic femoral aplasia/hypoplasia with the unusual facies and limb contractures, matching femoral hypoplasia-unusual facies syndrome. R4 explains oligohydramnios and short lower limbs but cannot explain femoral aplasia/hypoplasia or cleft lip/palate; R2 only accounts for micrognathia and cleft lip/palate while ignoring the skeletal and limb findings; R3 is a nonspecific placental event.

rejected.why: Only micrognathia and cleft lip/palate are captured; no femoral aplasia/hypoplasia, short lower limbs, or contractures are explained.
Abruptio placentae is nonspecific and cannot account for the distinctive femoral aplasia/hypoplasia, cleft lip/palate, or contractures.
